#!/bin/bash
# Generate 8 photorealistic frames for gongfangjian video (user rejected anime version)
set -u
IMG=/opt/eval-adapter/ecnu_tools.py
D=/workspace/project/images

STYLE="真实摄影风格，photorealistic sports photography，真实室内射箭运动馆场地（约半个足球场大小），真实光线，真实人物皮肤与表情，年轻中国人男女混合穿运动服戴护目镜护臂，专用美猎弓箭杆真实箭头为圆形泡沫安全头，红队蓝队颜色对立明亮色彩，动态运动跟拍感，类似游戏宣传片画面，画面禁止卡通动漫渲染禁止3D玩偶感。16:9宽屏横构图。"

python $IMG --text "$STYLE 广阔全景：两队各五名玩家在场地两端对峙，中间隔安全中立区黄色边界线，充气掩体分布在两侧，一名玩家拉弦瞄准特写在前景，箭矢飞出带动态轨迹。" --output $D/shot1.png && echo OK1
python $IMG --text "$STYLE 俯视航拍视角：整个场地划分图，左半场地面红色区域红线，右半场蓝色区域蓝线，中间黄色安全带，两侧各放三个圆形箭靶和充气掩体，场边队员穿戴护具持弓准备。" --output $D/shot2.png && echo OK2
python $IMG --styles-ignored 2>/dev/null; python $IMG --text "$STYLE 开局冲刺瞬间：十名年轻玩家从两侧冲向中线抢箭，动作大幅动态模糊，箭支散放在中线地面上，红蓝运动服交错，低角度跟踪镜头，紧张刺激氛围。" --output $D/shot3.png && echo OK3
python $IMG --text "$STYLE 激烈攻防：红队玩家躲在红色充气掩体后侧身射箭，蓝队玩家侧身闪避来箭，另一名蓝队玩家伸手精彩接住一支泡沫头箭，空中带轻微光效，两米外红队玩家被击中后单膝跪地举手示意出局，无血腥。" --output $D/shot4.png && echo OK4
python $IMG --text "$STYLE 箭靶攻击：多支泡沫头箭精准射向蓝队后场的三个立式圆形箭靶，其中一个靶被击中正在掉落，箭矢空中轨迹清晰，动态特写。" --output $D/shot5.png && echo OK5
python $IMG --text "$STYLE 高潮决胜慢动作：最后一名红队玩家与最后一名蓝队玩家对射，两支箭在空中交错飞过，浅景深慢镜头质感，背景队友紧张注视，一箭命中最后一个靶子瞬间。" --output $D/shot6.png && echo OK6
python $IMG --text "$STYLE 安全装备特写：一名笑容灿烂的年轻女玩家正面特写，清晰展示护目镜和护臂，手持美猎弓，背景虚化的射箭馆，明亮温暖光线。" --output $D/shot7.png && echo OK7
python $IMG --text "$STYLE 结束画面：红队蓝队两队十名玩家在场地中央开心合影，两队队长握手，众人竖大拇指，背后是箭靶和掩体，明亮欢快氛围。" --output $D/shot8.png && echo OK8
echo DONE

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Compose gongfangjian real-style promo: Ken Burns per shot + titles + narration subtitles + VO
import json, os, subprocess, shlex

D = "/workspace/project"
OUT = "/workspace/outputs/gongfangjian_real.mp4"
FPS = 25
W, H = 1920, 1080
FONT = subprocess.run(["fc-match", "-f", "%{file}", "Noto Sans CJK SC"],
                      capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc"
FONTB = FONT.replace("Regular", "Bold") if os.path.exists(FONT.replace("Regular", "Bold")) else FONT

# shot: image, base duration, title (top), subtitle (bottom narration), vo file, motion
SHOTS = [
    dict(img="shot1.png", base=6.0, title="攻防箭小游戏", sub="来一场刺激的攻防对战吧！攻防箭——融合射箭与闪避球的团队大战！", vo="n1.mp3", motion="in"),
    dict(img="shot2.png", base=11.0, title=None, sub="场地分成两半，中间是安全区。每人一把弓和五支安全泡沫箭，被射中出局，接住箭可复活队友！", vo="n2.mp3", motion="left"),
    dict(img="shot3.png", base=6.0, title=None, sub="比赛开始！冲到中间抢箭，回到攻击区开战！", vo="n3.mp3", motion="in_fast"),
    dict(img="shot4.png", base=14.0, title=None, sub="躲！射！接箭复活！利用掩体走位，团队配合最重要！", vo="n4.mp3", motion="out"),
    dict(img="shot5.png", base=10.0, title=None, sub="别忘了攻击对方箭靶！先打掉所有靶子也能获胜！", vo="n5.mp3", motion="in"),
    dict(img="shot6.png", base=10.0, title="胜利！", sub="最后关头，一箭定胜负！团队合作才是王道！", vo="n6.mp3", motion="in_fast"),
    dict(img="shot7.png", base=6.0, title=None, sub="全程佩戴护目镜，安全第一，享受快乐对战！", vo="n7.mp3", motion="out"),
    dict(img="shot8.png", base=10.0, title="快来试试攻防箭！", sub="想玩吗？组队来一场吧！就来上海诚弓射箭馆！", vo="n8.mp3", motion="in"),
]

def probe_dur(p):
    r = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "quiet", "-show_entries", "format=duration",
                        "-of", "csv=p=0", p], capture_output=True, text=True)
    try:
        return float(r.stdout.strip())
    except Exception:
        return None

def motion_expr(kind, frames):
    x = "iw/2-(iw/zoom/2)"
    y = "ih/2-(ih/zoom/2)"
    if kind == "in":
        z = f"1+0.12*on/{frames}"
    elif kind == "in_fast":
        z = f"1+0.20*on/{frames}"
    elif kind == "out":
        z = f"1.12-0.12*on/{frames}"
    elif kind == "left":
        z = f"1.10"
        x = f"(iw-iw/zoom)*(1-on/{frames})"
    else:
        z = "1"
    return z, x, y

def textfile(path, text):
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(text)
    return path

os.makedirs(f"{D}/clips", exist_ok=True)
clips = []
total = 0.0
for i, s in enumerate(SHOTS, 1):
    vo_path = f"{D}/audio/{s['vo']}"
    dur = s["base"]
    if os.path.exists(vo_path):
        vd = probe_dur(vo_path)
        if vd:
            dur = max(dur, vd + 1.2)
    dur = round(dur, 2)
    frames = int(dur * FPS)
    total += dur
    z, x, y = motion_expr(s["motion"], frames)
    fc = (
        f"scale=3840:2160:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=3840:2160,"
        f"zoompan=z='{z}':x='{x}':y='{y}':d={frames}:s={W}x{H}:fps={FPS},format=yuv420p"
    )
    tf_title = tf_sub = None
    if s["title"]:
        tf_title = textfile(f"{D}/clips/t{i}_title.txt", s["title"])
        fc += (
            f",drawtext=fontfile='{FONTB}':textfile='{tf_title}':fontsize=110:fontcolor=white:"
            f"borderw=6:bordercolor=0xCC2222@0.9:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=h*0.10"
        )
    if s["sub"]:
        tf_sub = textfile(f"{D}/clips/t{i}_sub.txt", s["sub"])
        fc += (
            f",drawtext=fontfile='{FONT}':textfile='{tf_sub}':fontsize=44:fontcolor=white:"
            f"box=1:boxcolor=black@0.45:boxborderw=18:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=h*0.86"
        )
    cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loop", "1", "-i", f"{D}/images/{s['img']}"]
    if os.path.exists(vo_path):
        cmd += ["-i", vo_path]
        af = f"[1:a]adelay=600|600,apad[a]"
        cmd += ["-filter_complex", f"[{fc}][1:a]adelay=600|600,apad,atrim=0:{dur},volume=1.0[a]",
                "-map", "[v]" if False else "-map", "0:v", "-map", "[a]"]
        # simpler: build filter graph properly below
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loop", "1", "-i", f"{D}/images/{s['img']}", "-i", vo_path,
               "-filter_complex",
               f"[0:v]{fc}[v];[1:a]adelay=600|600,apad,atrim=0:{dur},volume=1.6[a]",
               "-map", "[v]", "-map", "[a]", "-t", str(dur)]
    else:
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loop", "1", "-i", f"{D}/images/{s['img']}",
               "-filter_complex", f"[0:v]{fc}[v]", "-map", "[v]", "-t", str(dur)]
    clip = f"{D}/clips/clip{i}.mp4"
    cmd += ["-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-crf", "19", "-r", str(FPS),
            "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", clip]
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(f"clip{i} failed:\n{r.stderr[-2000:]}")
    print(f"clip{i} ok dur={dur}", flush=True)
    clips.append(clip)

# concat
lst = f"{D}/clips/list.txt"
with open(lst, "w") as f:
    for c in clips:
        f.write(f"file '{c}'\n")
subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", lst,
                "-c", "copy", OUT], check=True, capture_output=True)
print(f"DONE total={total:.1f}s -> {OUT}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Download candidate real photos from Wikimedia Commons for each shot
import json, subprocess, os, urllib.parse, urllib.request

UA = {'User-Agent': 'GongFangJianVideo/1.0 (educational task)'}
QUERIES = {
    1: 'archery tag game',
    2: 'archery field range',
    3: 'archery tag action players',
    4: 'archery tag bow players',
    5: 'archery target arrow bullseye',
    6: 'archery competition shooting',
    7: 'archery armguard protective equipment',
    8: 'sports teams handshake high five',
}
API = 'https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php'

def api(params):
    params = dict(params, format='json')
    url = API + '?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
    return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30))

def dl(url, path):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r, open(path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(r.read())

os.makedirs('/workspace/project/candidates', exist_ok=True)
manifest = {}
for shot, q in QUERIES.items():
    try:
        r = api({'action': 'query', 'list': 'search', 'srsearch': q, 'srlimit': 6, 'srnamespace': 6})
        titles = [hit['title'] for hit in r['query']['search']]
        got = []
        for t in titles:
            ii = api({'action': 'query', 'titles': t, 'prop': 'imageinfo',
                      'iiprop': 'url|size|extmetadata', 'iiurlwidth': 1920})
            pages = ii['query']['pages']
            for p in pages.values():
                info = p.get('imageinfo', [{}])[0]
                if info.get('width', 0) < 1200:
                    continue
                mime = info.get('mime', '')
                if mime != 'image/jpeg':
                    continue
                thumb = info.get('thumburl') or info['url']
                fn = f"shot{shot}_{len(got)}.jpg"
                path = f"/workspace/project/candidates/{fn}"
                try:
                    dl(thumb, path)
                    meta = info.get('extmetadata', {})
                    lic = meta.get('LicenseShortName', {}).get('value', '?')
                    artist = meta.get('Artist', {}).get('value', '?')[:200]
                    got.append({'file': path, 'title': t, 'license': lic, 'artist': artist})
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f'shot{shot} dl fail {t}: {e}')
                if len(got) >= 3:
                    break
        manifest[shot] = got
        print(f'shot{shot} q={q!r} -> {len(got)} candidates')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'shot{shot} query fail: {e}')

with open('/workspace/project/candidates/manifest.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(manifest, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
print('DONE')

tools_supported.description: List configured agent ids with name/model/runtime metadata, allowed as `sessions_spawn(runtime:"subagent")` targets.

tools_supported.name: apply_patch
tools_supported.description: Patch one/many files. Input requires *** Begin Patch and *** End Patch.

input.description: Patch content using the *** Begin Patch/End Patch format.

tools_supported.name: edit
tools_supported.description: Exact single-file replacements. oldText unique/non-overlapping against original. Merge nearby changes; omit large unchanged spans.

oldText.description: Exact original text; unique and non-overlapping in this call.

edits.description: Targeted replacements against original file; no overlap/nesting. Merge nearby changes.

tools_supported.name: exec
tools_supported.description: Run shell now; background continuation supported. Completed calls return command output directly. Use process only when exec reports running with a sessionId; output text alone is not a process handle. Long run: automatic completion wake when enabled and output/failure occurs; otherwise process confirms completion. TTY CLI/UI/coding agent: pty=true. Quote arguments containing shell metacharacters, including URL query strings with `?` or `&`.

title.description: Every call: short purpose; never claim success. No secrets.

env.description: Literal overrides; no expansion. Omit to inherit.

ask.description: Requests stricter approvals under tools.exec.mode and host policy; channel-origin calls cannot override host ask=off.

tools_supported.name: ls
tools_supported.description: List directory entries in binary filename order, including dotfiles and links. Names are JSON-quoted; / marks actual directories. Pass the returned after cursor with the same path to continue.

after.description: Filename cursor returned by the previous page.

tools_supported.name: process
tools_supported.description: Control existing exec: list, poll, log, write, send-keys, submit, paste, kill. poll/log: status, output, quiet success, completion without auto-wake, input hints. Others: input/intervention.

sessionId.description: Required for every action except list.

keys.description: Key tokens to send for send-keys

hex.description: Hex bytes to send for send-keys

timeout.description: For poll: wait up to this many milliseconds before returning; max 30000 ms, higher values are clamped to 30000

tools_supported.name: read
tools_supported.description: Read text/image file (jpg/png/gif/webp/bmp); images attach to model context. Text caps 2000 lines or 50KB. Continue with offset/limit, or cursor within a long line.

cursor.description: Character position within the start line; 0-based.

optional.description: Missing paths return structured not_found instead of failing.
